lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Ag2Te4 (reduced formula DyAgTe2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies tetrahedral environments for all three elements: Ag is coordinated by four Te neighbors (2.90–2.94 Å), Dy by four Te neighbors (3.09–3.11 Å), and Te by one Ag and three Dy neighbors (2.90–3.11 Å). The connectivity forms a single 3-periodic component containing all 8 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ag and Dy tetrahedra and among Te tetrahedra.
